posts.cooked:
Episode #37 - Waiting for Capt Cosmos - ROUND 1

Introduction
The Ennead arrive on Mars, entering Wagner Mars Base to search for clues regarding the code keys necessary to enter the mysterious Sand Caves.  Unknown to them, the mothballed base's museum exhibit of the Mars Rover actually contains a refurbished vehicle!  It's camera records their break-in and relays a signal to Earth.  Soon afterwards, a team of heroes arrives to investigate.

Enter Tefnut [29], Set [26], Nuit [28], Isis [26], and Osiris [27].

Villain Turn
Start of turn- Nephtwys [28] enters play from under The Shrine (Advanced Ennead)

Play - Mass Overheating (one-shot, RED)
 - Destroy 4 Equipment cards
 - Tefnut deals each hero target 3 fire damage; Setback [28], Fanatic [28], Naturalist [26], Argent Adept [20], Nightmist [24]
 (RED CARD)
 - Set triggers play of top card of villain deck
  Play - Shn's Fury (one-shot, RED)
   - Tefnut deals each hero target 3 fire damage; Setback [25], Fanatic [25], Naturalist [23], Argent Adept [17], Nightmist [21]
 - Nuit tries to regains 2 HP, but is at Max HP

End of turn - None

=======
Effects:
- At the start of the villain turn move the top card from beneath the Shrine of the Ennead into the villain play area.  (Ennead - Advanced)
- Reduce damage dealt to villain targets other than Nuit by 1 (Nuit)

- The first time a (green) Ennead card is put into the villain trash each turn, Tefnut deals the hero target with the lowest HP 2 melee damage (Tefnut)
- The first time a (green) Ennead card is put into the villain trash each turn, Set deals each hero target 1 lightning damage (Set)
- The first time a (green) Ennead card is put into the villain trash each turn, Nephtwys deals each hero target 1 fire damage (Nephtwys)

- The first time a (red) Ennead card is put into the villain trash each turn, play the top card of the villain deck (Set)
- The first time a (red) Ennead card is put into the villain trash each turn, Nuit regains 2 HP (Nuit)

- The first time a (green) or (purple) Ennead card is put into the villain trash each turn, Isis deals the hero with the most cards in play 2 infernal damage. (Isis)
- The first time a (purple) Ennead card is put into the villain trash each turn, each player discards 1 card and each hero deals themself 1 psychic damage. (Osiris)
- the first time a (purple) Ennead card is put into the villain trash each turn, each villain target regains 1 HP. (Nephtwys)


Status
======
Tefnut [29] (-1)
Set [26] (-1)
Nuit [28]
Isis [26] (-1)
Osiris [27] (-1)
Nephtwys [28] (-1)

Villain Trash: Mass Overheating (RED), SHN's Fury (RED)

-------
Setback                       [25]
Fanatic (Redeemer)     [25]
Naturalist                    [23]
Argent Adept (Kvorthe) [17]
Nightmist                    [21]
 

Summary: 6 of the 9 Ennead are active.  Two red cards inflict six damage on each hero.  No equipment destroyed.  Setback is up.
